lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: # comprehende-59: Mobile layout

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: PR #59. One Bugbot review comment, not addressed. The source ticket is #58, but neither the PR nor its commits link to it, so the skill cannot find it. The case keeps it out of the frozen sources on purpose.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Story

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Title: the PR title.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Why: absent. The PR says what changes, not why. The motive is only in #58, which nothing links. The case checks that the skill does not invent a motive from the patch.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Size: medium.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Parts: one story. Groups: 3 to 5. The `App.tsx` routing branch can be its own group.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Groups

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 1. Mobile shell: `MobileShell.tsx`, the narrow branch in `App.tsx`, `src/ui/lib/narrow.ts`, `selectionCaption` in `selection.ts` with its test, the `ThemeToggle` export, compact `Sidebar`. The hook, the caption, and the sheet can be a foundation group before the shell.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 2. Main pane moved into `ReviewStage.tsx`. The JSX is the same as before, with new props. This can merge with group 1 because `App.tsx` holds both.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 3. Compact styles below 800px: the responsive class changes in `GroupBrief.tsx`, `Overview.tsx`, `Inspector.tsx`, `CopyPrompt.tsx`, `HunkView.tsx`, `Group.tsx`, `FileStrip` in `FileNav.tsx`, `styles.css`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 4. Sheet primitive: `src/ui/components/ui/sheet.tsx` (shadcn output), `@radix-ui/react-dialog` in `package.json`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Must state

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Bugbot says that hiding the "Viewed" label leaves a 14px tap target on phones. At head the label is still hidden.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Good to state

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - The PR says wrap, comments, and theme stay as icons. The mobile header also drops Refresh, the pinned range, and the coverage status. #58 asks to remove non-crucial elements, so this is intended, but the reader cannot see that from the PR. Without the coverage status, a phone reader does not see unassigned or stale counts.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - The desktop layout does not change. Each mobile style is either a `max-[799px]:` class or has a `min-[800px]:` value that restores the old one.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - The commits added three layouts behind `?design=` and then removed two. Only the overlay layout is at head.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Must not

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not write a document why. "Make the review usable on phones" is a guess from the patch.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not call the dropped header items a deviation. No available source asks to keep them.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not claim a `?design=` switch exists.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not make a group each for the hook, the caption, the stage, and the shell.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Baseline

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - 6 of 6 runs wrote a document why.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - 6 of 6 runs stated the Bugbot claim.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - 0 of 6 noted the dropped Refresh and coverage.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Runs made 6 to 9 groups, the worst over-split of all cases.
